images.caption: A view from Saana fell in the municipality of Enontekiö in Lapland, Finland. The stones on the right are one of the several stone stacks that the numerous visitors to Saana have gathered to the top of the fell. On the left a part of lake Kilpisjärvi is visible. The lake on the right is called Siilasjärvi. The closest fell in the picture is Pikku-Malla and behind that is Iso-Malla, both in the Malla Strict Nature Reserve.
images.alt: A view from Saana fell in the municipality of Enontekiö in Lapland, Finland. The stones on the right are one of the several stone stacks that the numerous visitors to Saana have gathered to the top of the fell. On the left a part of lake Kilpisjärvi is visible. The lake on the right is called Siilasjärvi. The closest fell in the picture is Pikku-Malla and behind that is Iso-Malla, both in the Malla Strict Nature Reserve.
